item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Monday, November 2. Monday again. Let's start the week well! Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be damp with light drizzle. Temperatures will go up to 20 degrees, with a low of 13. It should feel pleasantly mild. There is a 100 percent chance of rain. Did you know today is day 306 of the year? There are 59 days to go until the new one. Pack your umbrella and your wellies! As for tomorrow, expect it to be grey from start to finish, with a high of 21 degrees. This week our theme is animals getting ready for winter. They are busy now. That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
